project.name: Rune DSL IR-routed Java Generation
project.description: The IR-routed Java generation route (D43 PR-2): the IR-aware generator/compiler/renderer subclasses that drive declaration and expression emission from the rune-ir substrate while reusing the legacy renderer oracles verbatim (the byte-parity discipline), ported from the frozen IR-lab tree at its HEAD 8c14592 (2026-07-01). Registers the rune-java-generator IRGenerationProvider service (the ServiceLoader inversion of the lab's flag dispatch) — the route activates only behind -Drosetta.generator.ir=true with this jar on the classpath; the shipping generator carries zero IR imports and is byte-identical with the flag off. Depends on rune-ir + rune-java-generator BY DESIGN (legacy-renderer reuse — the D43 module family).
